For the Hegotá agenda: EIP-8198 (Quick Slots) now has an upstream-facing executable EL implementation of the schedule-driven direction.

- execution-specs PR: https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/pull/3473
- current EIP rewrite: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12217
- current validated EL head: `4bef25e89530a6ea2fc46709db910d5b655b241b`
- current Amsterdam base: `ef914fe55dd252b60a718fec013ae2a6ee15054e`
- exact validation: https://github.com/chugarchugarr/execution-specs/actions/runs/33544231268

The implementation preserves the current Hegotá-facing behavior while using synthetic later duration eras only to prove that the same production paths compose without new duration-specific EL branches.

One specification distinction remains narrow and explicit: one-time capacity transitions use `new / old`, while persistent base-fee wall-clock responsiveness uses `active / pre-schedule-base` on every block. The EL proof exercises repeated eras so those two semantics cannot collapse after the first transition.

The question I would like resolved during EIP-8198 discussion is: should the EL side pay the refactor cost once so later slot-duration reductions become schedule/config changes rather than new transition-specific execution logic?
Following the discussing from ACDT on Monday, I want to close the decision on EIP-8037 changes (https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/2204#issuecomment-5461653738)

Hegotá related agenda items: I want to give an update to client teams on recent developments around the following EIPs that are PFI-ed for H*:

* [EIP-8148](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-8148):
  * EIP [updated](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12245) to adapt latest EIP specification
  * [Feature spec](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/tree/master/specs/_features/eip8148) added in consensus spec repo.
  * System [contract PR](https://github.com/ethereum/sys-asm/pull/54) opened in the sys-asm repo.
  * POC Draft from Prysm: https://github.com/OffchainLabs/prysm/pull/17338
  * [Tests are ready](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/5565) (wait only for CFI status for the PR)
 
* [EIP-8205](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-8205): 
  * EIP [updated](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12184) to adapt latest Gloas specification
  * [Feature spec](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/tree/master/specs/_features/eip8205) added ([PR](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/5548)) in consensus spec repo.
  * System[ contract PR](https://github.com/ethereum/sys-asm/pull/55) opened in the sys-asm repo.
  * Landing page to track all updates: https://eip8205.com/
